title: moeb-tool-origin failed: ToolSearch and Read used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: During this fix_signal run, ToolSearch was used twice to load deferred MCP tool schemas, and Read was used three times to read the oversized fix_signal result file at an absolute system path. Neither tool is in the moeb registry. No MissingMoebTool signals were written after any of these calls.
proposed_resolution: When processing oversized fix_signal output requires external tools, immediately write MissingMoebTool signals. Existing catalogue signals for ToolSearch (9e8d7c6b) and Read large-output (f7e8d9c0) should be incremented.
